name: knowledge-db
description: YS-Codebase Knowledge Database & Semantic Retrieval Module

server.hint: 提供常駐背景檔案監聽熱自癒、極速預熱派發與 touch_activity 保活能力

onboarding: [Pre-flight] Configure project workspaces in config/file-space/contribute.json and optional retrieval weights in config/knowledge-db/contribute.json (space_weights)
Optional - Download local ONNX vector model (or use lightweight BM25 via config set knowledge-db enable_vector_search false): python yscb.py knowledge-db model download
Build unified AST & BM25/vector index: python yscb.py knowledge-db index
Search symbols & code snippets: python yscb.py knowledge-db search "<query>" -s

release.summary: 模型權重與檢索索引對齊至 storage.local://knowledge-db，本機組態對齊 config.local://，跨進程鎖分離至 cache://，並提供 1.2.1.x.py 自動遷移
